A small investment fund has \$100,000 to allocate to a single opportunity. The fund must choose one investment before knowing how market conditions will unfold.
Option A is a government bond that will return a guaranteed profit of \$4,000.
Option B is a diversified equity fund that has a 60% chance of earning a \$7,000 profit and a 40% chance of earning \$1,000.
Option C is a speculative investment in an emerging technology company that has a 30% chance of earning a \$20,000 profit and a 70% chance of losing \$5,000.
The investment decision must be made today, before market outcomes are known. Which option would you recommend the fund choose?
